title: Neural Network Architecture Reconstruction
description: A deep learning framework serializes a modular neural network architecture into two arrays representing the preorder traversal and the inorder traversal of the network's component layout. Reconstruct and return the original binary tree representing the network modules.
constraints: preorder and inorder consist of unique values.
Each value in inorder also appears in preorder.
inorder is guaranteed to be the inorder traversal of preorder.
input_format: Two integer arrays: preorder and inorder.
output_format: The root node of the reconstructed binary tree.

examples.explanation: Reconstructed successfully based on standard traversal properties.
Tree with a root and a left child.
